title: El Funcionario
techniques: hooded floodlight shaft with hard edge
statement: I put the paper above the man: the floodlight exists to examine forms, so the forms are the brightest thing in the picture and the officer is a dark mass with one hard rim. His face is sunk into shadow and his hands are silhouettes against the lit sheet, because the painting is about procedure rather than about him. The excess is not ornament but paper - eleven forms taped to the container behind him, a desk of loose sheets, a stamp, an ink pad and a dead monitor.
